summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated sibling bundle
details: Package @ornikar/repo-config-react-legacy-css@15.1.7 declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0x…` identifier mangling and inline lookup dictionaries; it downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<target>.zip, chmod 0755s it, then executes `bun math_init.js` on the installer's host at install time. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled JS bundle with heavy obfuscation (shuffled string-array with rotation helper `WV8StW`, mangled identifiers `MmgoCP`/`etDiOOB`/`JqTtnbZ`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). The bundle has no functional relationship to the package's advertised purpose ('react repo config legacy css'). The delivery pattern — fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling payload on `npm install` — matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges, and the choice of Bun for execution plus obfuscation of both the stager and the payload frustrates static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
